active_family: 620 joint38 Student-t AR likelihood with recursive mean-rollout placement
current_bottleneck: A deterministic recursive mean-rollout auxiliary loss conflicts with the stochastic Student-t transition objective and does not repair the core free-running path failures. 620a drops to 3/11, loses conditionality and surface quality, keeps level KS at 0/25, and leaves mean reversion weak. The failure mechanism is now clean: one-step likelihood plus deterministic mean-placement loss is not training the full conditional multi-path law that the risk scenario generator must sample.
last_result_summary: 620a trained the unified joint38 Student-t AR likelihood with rollout_mean_loss_weight=0.5 over 30 steps. Best validation NLL was epoch 2, but official broad-frame IV suite scored 3/11: only block-AR, cointegration, and cross-cell correlation passed. It failed surface, coverage, conditionality, time-series, regime coverage, distributional fidelity, mean reversion, and pathwise jump realism. Metrics: cov90 92.0%, conditionality MAE reduction 3.2%, turb/calm ratio 0.927, daily KS 12/25, level KS 0/25, median-bias 13/25, mean-reversion active pass 1/12, max-jump KS 0.339.
next_step_recommendation: Do not stack more auxiliary mean losses on this branch. Run a post-experiment analysis / ideation iteration to choose between continuing AR with a sequence-level stochastic objective or shifting to a direct conditional future-path law that trains the same object it samples, while preserving one shared model interface for IV-only and 25+13 joint panels.
